quantize-palette.mjs --k 64: one OKLab k-means over the three views
rig prepare(): the profile mirrored to face left; thin strands and islands removed (cleanStrands), one-texel slits closed (closeSlits), soles on row 90 and feet centred (align)

rig frames(): idle = rest, rest, inhale, exhale (rig-engine breath); run, profile = the upper body leaning 2 texels with the cape's tail trailing, two legs painted in the view's trousers / boot ramps by two-bone IK with the view's boot foot, contact / push / flight x 2, planted foot 9 texels per frame; run, front / back = body bob and weight shift, cape sway, each leg lifted under the body, both in the flight frames
build-character.mjs: frame checks (contract section 3), Aseprite assembly (tags <anim>-<dir>), export compared pixel for pixel with the rig frames
